text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of Members of Council to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors.

City Council on June 29 and 30, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Members to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities Board of Directors for a term starting at the Annual Meeting in 2020 to the Annual Meeting in 2021: Councillor Ana Bailão Councillor Mike Colle
